scope: Uganda medical discovery — Makerere University College of Health Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: Makerere University College of Health Sciences lists Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery among the School of Medicine's undergraduate programmes.

Makerere's College of Health Sciences states that its undergraduate MBChB diploma-entry scheme requires a health or biological-science diploma and at least two years of relevant work experience; degree-holder applications are considered case by case under university guidelines.
Makerere's medical-school elective page states that placements are available at Mulago Hospital and other Makerere-affiliated hospitals, with possible district-hospital and rural-clinic placements.
Makerere University states that all its academic programmes and affiliated-institution programmes are accredited by Uganda's National Council for Higher Education.

holdReasons: Current direct-entry MBChB admission requirements and Medicine-specific fee data were not sufficiently assembled for the required payload fields.
An explicit current teaching-language and student-support evidence set remains incomplete for publication.
